notes.title: Slimekeep Update V1.11
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, I'm happy to announce a pretty large update for Slimekeep that adds controller support! You guys have asked me so many times now to add this and it's finally here, so I hope you enjoy. [/p][p][/p][p]I will just leave a few disclaimers regarding this update to be clear however:[/p][olist][*][p]Things may not be perfect. I've tried my best to test everything but there very well may be issues I'm unaware of, so if you encounter any controller-specific oddities, please let me know by reporting them in my [url="https://discord.gg/QFE73Nh7WP"]Discord[/url] server.[/p][/*][*][p]Unfortunately this update may not bring support for all controllers out there. From testing, Xbox, Playstation, and Steam controllers seem to all work perfectly. However, I have had issues specifically with Nintendo Switch controllers and other third party ones. So I'm really sorry, but I can't guarantee these controllers will work with this update. This is because I developed Slimekeep on a very old version of unity that is unable to update to the newest version of the input system I am using, so I really apologize for this. You may however be able to get around this by using a controller emulator or via steam input.[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of steam input, it should hopefully be disabled by default, but if you have previously enabled it, be sure to disable it from your steam library! Steam input conflicts with the native support I have added and may lead to issues.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Anyways, I hope you enjoy this update and please let me know what you think! I really don't play too many games on controllers so I'm not the most familiar with the best default key binds, or general player preferences, so if you have any suggestions, I'm happy to hear them. Also stay tuned for my devlog on how I added controller which will be out this later this week![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39883854/99552c65dabe485ae39fbe2861a75abee09197c6.png"][/img][/p][p]I've also fixed a few bugs in this update, so here they are:[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] [list][*][p]Capped Hoarder upgrade's damage buff to 100% max  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare bug where dialogue didn’t show in the Apartments or Goo Station  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a persistent bug where the player couldn’t leave the house after toggling house skins  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken behavior for Shield Slime  
[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Slime Rush slimeball system to never drop more than 100 slimeballs per round  
[/p][/*][*][p]Adventurer NPC can no longer spawn in Challenge Mode  
[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed Double Shot and Triple Shot upgrades (less punishing damage nerfs)  
[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled opening Challenge Mode panel while reloading  
[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked “Super Rush Ready” popup logic to not trigger early  
[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized slimeball spawn effect in late-stage Slime Rush to reduce lag  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with the Mailman Slime Rush upgrade  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Digger Slime error in Slime Rush  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss chest item pickup glitch when collecting too quickly  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Digger Slime death animation not playing in Slime Rush  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Goo Station weapon duplication exploit  
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Coiler weapon not working in Slime Rush  
[/p][/*][*][p]Player’s total damage nerfing can no longer go below -50%  
[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Gladiator Slime from Slime Rush  
[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly nerfed slimeball drops from Stage 2 slimes in the pen  
[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision checks to prevent player or slimes getting stuck inside walls during Slime Rush  
[/p][/*][/list][/p][p]Happy sliming,  [/p][p]BenBonk[/p]

notes.title: Slimekeep Update V1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm happy to announce Slimekeep's first major update. The big changes for this update are a rework to the challenge mode and the launch of the Slimekeep OST. This update also features many bug and softlock fixes. I still have some more patches that will be coming shortly in the coming weeks fixing a few more known bugs, but really wanted to get this update out to everyone. Anyways let's get into it!

[h2]Slimekeep OST[/h2]
I'm thrilled to announce that the official Slimekeep soundtrack is now available on all major streaming services! Enjoy listening to a song in game? Well now you can listen to it all you want, wherever you want! I will also be launching the OST for purchase through steam in the coming days for $2.99 if you would like to support the composers who worked hard to create it. I'm just waiting on steam to approve the OST for sale at the moment, but this shouldn't take long!

Stream the OST here: [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/55cz7xkQ0CPWAfe1TWvRn2]Spotify[/url], [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/slimekeep-original-soundtrack/1817279127]Apple Music[/url], [url=https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_mVrO2WCO0udjwzxkivnzcmG-ytW_l-U4w]Youtube Music[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39883854/debd944adb4ed6702fc4854aa257e90a4cb0b088.png[/img]

[h2]Challenge Mode Rework[/h2]
I received a lot of feedback that certain player's wanted more of a challenge from this mode, and thought it lacked depth, so I have created a full rework of the system to make it much more fun and customizable in difficulty!  If you don't know, the challenge mode in the game unlocks after beating the slime king once, and can be accessed from the left of the player's house in the start screen hub. Previously, this challenge mode would apply a random modifier each day making the game more difficult.  Example modifiers could be having missiles fall from the sky every few seconds in combat, or increased weapon reload time. 

As mentioned above, I've reworked this system be more dynamic and tuned to the player's difficulty desires. I've taken inspiration from games like Balatro's "stakes" system and Inscryption's "Kaycee's Mod" to create something that will hopefully be fun to play around with. Now, instead of their just being a random debuff/modifier each day in the game while in challenge mode, I've introduced "chaos levels". There are a total of 8 chaos levels in the game, starting with chaos level 1. Chaos level 1 requires you to beat the game with 1 modifier active, in which afterwards you will unlock chaos level 2 which requires 2 modifiers, and so on. Can you get to chaos level 8? Let me know, and let me know what you think of this new system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39883854/7b20c3fd50193fec3b4b811ebfe338d16f022217.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
I've also worked on many bug fixes and small changes for this update. Here they are:
[list]
[*]Fixed a timeout issue with the level generator that could cause a softlock on the loading screen
[*]Fixed a bug where slimes sometimes become uncapturable (I don't know for sure though this is super hard to replicate lol)
[*]Fixed Chopper boss corpse sometimes blocking the chest drop
[*]Fixed a bug where the player literally couldn’t leave the house
[*]Fixed a bug with the Dasher upgrade that caused the player to deal 0 damage
[*]Fixed a visual bug with the shopkeeper in the keep
[*]Fixed an infinite dash bug when using the Dash of Doom upgrade
[*]Fixed another sneaky day loading softlock
[*]Fixed "slroulette" typo in Billy's Tavern NPC dialogue
[*]Increased particle density for mole/digger slime
[*]Very subtly buffed currency drops for dual-type slimes when captured
[*]Added a dark background behind tutorial boat room text for readability
[*]Fixed pet weapon shooting absurdly fast with Cappuccino/Espresso Rush upgrades
[*]Fixed teleporting to puddles outside available bounds causing errors
[*]Fixed a few bugs/minor issues with the secret boss fight (hehe)
[/list]

Anyways, what's next for Slimekeep? Well I still have some bugs to fix (not sure how I haven't squashed all of them yet, I swear they keep popping up so sorry about this!), but after that I will definitely be looking into adding controller support. I can't promise anything right now, because I'm not sure if this will even be viable due to the game's underlying architecture, but I'll try my best and keep you guys updated. I will also likely be taking a break from active development sometime in the near future as I really need one, so we'll see how that goes. But don't worry, I'll still make sure to keep these updates flowing for now!

Happy sliming,
BenBonk

notes.title: Slimekeep Update V1.05
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this update brings a ton of improvements to the Slime Rush mode, alongside some more polish and bug fixes. Please note that updates may start to slow down over the next few weeks. I currently have finals to start studying for so my time will be limited to work on Slimekeep. 

[h2]Slime Rush Tweaks[/h2] [list]
[*]Added 5 new Slime Rush-specific upgrades!
[*]Slimeball drops now scale exponentially by round: 30 × 1.15^(round - 1) 
[*]Player now gains 1 special slimeball per round completed in Slime Rush
[*]Removed certain incompatible upgrades from appearing in Slime Rush 
[*]Added round number text to the bottom corner of the screen in Slime Rush
[*]Fixed a Slime Rush softlock caused by unkillable enemies
[*]Fixed pit softlocks in Slime Rush
[*]Fixed visual stacking issue with grass in Slime Rush[/list]
[h2]Visual and Gameplay Improvements[/h2] [list] [*]Made mech boss minion nuts and bolts more visible with a yellow outline 
[*]Reflected projectiles from the Samurai boss now have yellow outlines and move slower (6c31c8e)
[*]Samurai boss slightly nerfed to make the fight less tanky 
[*]Chopper boss’s death ring no longer deals damage
[*]Samurai knives stuck to walls no longer deal damage 
[*]Digger Slime no longer glows while digging
[*]Added a laser sound effect to the DJ boss fight lasers
[*]Added screenshake to the Chopper boss death animation  [/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] [list] [*]Fixed grass and decorations spawning inside pits/walls in Slime Rush 
[*]Fixed player being unable to open the pause menu in the Keep
[*]Fixed save data incorrectly persisting between the tutorial and main game
[*]Fixed the “Lucky Loot” upgrade not saving properly
[*]Super Rush “ready” light now properly disappears when entering buildings [/list]
Thanks for playing and diving into Slime Rush! Keep the bug reports and feedback coming by reporting them to my [url=https://discord.gg/VR5NY295YP]Discord[/url].

Happy sliming,
BenBonk

notes.title: Slimekeep Update V1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've got a smaller patch for you today aimed at tightening up gameplay, squashing bugs, and making your weapons feel as impactful as they should. 

As always, if you run into any issues, I’d love for you to report them (ideally with video context!) over in the [url=https://discord.gg/VR5NY295YP]Discord[/url].
[h2]Gameplay/Balance Changes[/h2]
[list] [*]Buffed almost every weapon to make them feel more satisfying, especially during boss fights like the Slime King
[*]Enemies now fall into pits if you fail a capture while one is standing over one
[*]Rush Mode now gives a default 50% damage boost even with no upgrades
[*]Made it possible to unlock the “Undercover Business” achievement if all weapons were unlocked before the last update
[*]Ammo cost in Slimeazon has been slightly reduced
[*]Lowered the shopkeeper pen cost when it includes ammo
[*]Reverted the ammo changes from the previous patch—it was a bit too harsh
[*]Nerfed the Pistol Powder upgrade: now gives +50% damage instead of +100%
[*]Added a lore room spawn to Day 2
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list] [*]Fixed adventurer NPC spawning inside of walls
[*]Fixed bullet multiplier sometimes not affecting enemies while Super Rush is active
[*]Fixed fog bug when entering buildings on days that use custom tilesets
[*]Fixed invincibility bug with the slime king
[*]Fixed a tile issue on the bottom of chests in minigame rooms
[*]Fixed rocket launchers not tagging enemies for your pet to attack when in manual mode
[*]Fixed a softlock when pausing the game right after being hit with the Stopwatch upgrade
[*]Fixed sea in the boat room blocking bullets
[*]Fixed sleepy slimes being able to shoot while in their death animation
[*]Player can now actually bind the “H” key properly
[/list]
Hope you enjoy these changes! Let me know what’s working (or not!) and keep the feedback coming :)

Happy slimekeeping,
BenBonk

notes.title: Slimekeep Update V1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Time for another patch :)

Thank you all for continuing to play and support Slimekeep! This patch includes a bunch of bug fixes, polish, quality-of-life improvements, and a few balance tweaks based on your feedback.

As always, please report any bugs or issues on the Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/VR5NY295YP]https://discord.gg/VR5NY295YP[/url]

Here are the changes I have made over the past few days:

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list] [*]Double Trouble pet upgrade now has a 50% chance to capture an extra slime (was 100%)
[*]Reward chests are now less likely to drop weapons, and it's rarer for them to drop 2 items at once
[*]Reduced all weapon ammos by 25-50%, most of them just had too much imo, making ammo drops feel unnecessary
[*]Removed one chest room from Day 2 to slightly delay the early powerspike
[*]Slightly nerfed the Slime King crown attack, it was a bit too tricky to dodge
[*]Boss chests now drop health and either a weapon OR an upgrade, not both
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]Added a check to hopefully fix pet slime spawning extra projectiles/turrets with teleport upgrade
[*]Casino music no longer plays where it shouldn’t
[*]Fixed a weird bug where time would go slow-mo after killing an enemy in a pit
[*]Fixed a specific pit not working correctly
[*]Fixed a major bug where the pet’s weapon would stop firing randomly
[*]Fixed a softlock with bomb slime
[*]Fixed a softlock with the spiky skin upgrade (doors wouldn’t open)
[*]Fixed a tileset override bug in the T-shaped enemy room
[*]Fixed a few slime king attack hitboxes that were blocking bullets
[*]Fixed a typo in "crosshair size" setting
[*]Fixed a typo in the faster fire Slimeinator upgrade
[*]Fixed the mech boss projectile trails not working on override days
[*]Fixed bosses jarringly appearing after intro screen
[*]Fixed bug where the arcade machine in the basement would be invisible sometimes
[*]Fixed pet sometimes overshooting enemies when on auto-attack and very close
[*]Fixed jarring camera transitions when beating DJ and Chopper bosses
[*]Fixed some music bugs when pausing at the start of a boss fight
[*]Fixed the room cleared popup not working on some override days
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and Small Tweaks[/h2]
[list] [*]Tutorial now includes text clarifying how to unlock Super Rush upgrades
[*]You can no longer get hit by bazooka/scythe challenge modifier during boss intro sequences
[*]You can no longer pick up the battery outside of the shop pen
[*]Pet weapons are now disabled during the memory minigame
[*]Prevented the statue NPC guy from spawning too close to walls
[*]Tileset override days can no longer happen on boss days (they were breaking transitions)
[*]Chest opening animations are now smoother
[*]Fixed some minor tileset issues in boss room entrances
[*]Cutscene view text now fades out when you can't interact anymore
[*]Updated boss intro texts to be higher resolution and easier to read
[*]Removed a duplicate shooting target from the start screen shooting range
[*]Chopper boss now has a proper intro animation instead of popping in suddenly
[/list]
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list] [*]4 new achievements have been added!
[/list]
That’s all for now! Thanks again for playing, and I hope these fixes and updates make the game feel even better. And please do keep the feedback and clips of bugs coming as they are super valuable to me as a developer!

Happy slime hunting,
BenBonk

notes.title: Slimekeep Update V1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]I'm happy to announce Slimekeep's first update since launch![/h1]

Firstly, thank you everyone for a successful release! There didn't seem to be anything too game breaking which was great to see. However, I am still aware of a few issues with the capturing system and some other things that are very difficult to replicate, so if you do ever run into any bugs, video recordings with plenty of context goes a long way in helping me fix these!

Please report any bugs you may encounter to my discord server here: [url=https://discord.gg/VR5NY295YP]Discord[/url]

In this post I will explain some of new additions, bug fixes, and tweaks I have made to hopefully make the game more balanced and less buggy!

Let's start with game balance. I've received a fair bit of feedback that the game is too easy. This has been a challenge for me in development because I want to make sure the game is accessible to all, but also challenging. Although currently it seems like the current game is a tad too easy in general, which I've been working to fix. It felt like too many people were getting overpowered runs early in the game loop or on their first or second attempts, and shredding boss health bars. While I love seeing the chaos of an overpowered build in action, I think the ease of getting powerful items needs to be toned down to emphasize the risk reward nature of the game, as well as making bosses more difficult in general. Here are some of my changes in this regard:

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Major[/h3]
[*]Increased all bosses health anywhere from 20-50% health to make them more challenging
[*]Increased boss damage caps/meat shields so they take a bit longer to kill with a busted build
[*]Gave the pet's weapon a 50% fire rate decrease by default as his base DPS felt a little too high
[*]Made the health shop pens cost slightly more
[*]Pretty heavily nerfed later stage/later difficulty slimes to drop less slimeballs
[*]Generally increased most upgrade costs to make them more balanced
[*]Decreased super rush buff time from 20 seconds to 12 seconds by default

[h3]Minor[/h3]
[*]Nerfed the better battery pet upgrade
[*]Made the capture loot bars slightly rarer and more difficult to hit
[*]Nerfed the battery add from capture minigame bars to be +100 instead of +250
[*]Nerfed boss slimeball drops from boss chests as they dropped far too many
[*]Slightly tweaked a few weapon prices to be more fair (sorry rocket launcher!)
[*]Increased tier 1 and tier 2 pet upgrade costs by 5 special currency each
[*]Nerfed slimy/slimier surge super rush upgrades to increase buff duration by 5 seconds each instead of 10
[*]Made it rarer for a tier 2 weapon to drop from a reward chest
[*]Greatly decreased the chance for item drops after clearing rooms
[*]Changed slime armor upgrade to give +2 max health instead of +4
[/list]
Next, here is a general list of bug fixes and new additions I've made over the past two days.

[h2]Other changes and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Randomized the start screen theme at the start of the game
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could not open the pause menu/minimap after playing darts
[*]Fixed a few softlocks and bugs in slime rush mode
[*]Clarified the home/restart/quit confirm text to be more clear on when the game actually saves
[*]Fixed a dialogue bug when purchasing goo in the goo station
[*]Fixed a softlock when playing slroulette/slimejack in the casino
[*]Ensured all projectiles/attacks are now destroyed after killing a boss or clearing a room
[*]Added some clarifying text to the slimeinator panels
[*]Fixed a few of the slime king's attacks having lingering hitboxes
[*]Slightly tweaked slime panicking when being captured to be a bit more engaging
[*]Added more guiding text after clearing the tutorial
[*]TNT craters now don't appear in places they shouldn't be
[/list]
Hopefully you all understand these changes and please let me know what you think! I am always open to feedback. And again, if you encounter any bugs please do try to report them to the discord above and send a video your gameplay as well as the full context behind it so I have a better chance at identifying and fixing the bug. Happy slimekeeping everyone!

notes.title: Slimekeep Is Out Now!
notes.content:
After five years of development, I am thrilled to announce that Slimekeep has officially launched! That's right, you can play the game right now. This has truly been the craziest journey of my life and I'm so grateful to everyone who has supported me throughout this process. 

The game currently has a 20% launch discount for the remainder of the week. It may not gone on sale again soon, so now is your chance to pick up the game if you are interested in playing or just want to support me as a developer!

Additionally, if you want to see the story of how the game was developed, also check out my recap devlog. Here, I summarize Slimekeep's five year development into 17 minutes and reflect on the journey.

[previewyoutube=Kpdwzqg3l54;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, thanks for reading, and I hope you all have fun with the game!
